newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends firmer as dollar supply rises.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends firmer as dollar supply rises.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 680-685 per dollar, a touch firmer than the morning's 683-688, with dollar supply outstripping demand in lively interbank trade, dealers said.
"Trade was much livelier and in larger volumes today as dollar supply edged up in the afternoon," one dealer said.

"Large fuel importers bid for dollars and the lev was expected to ease from the opening, but supply rose when other final clients started to offer dollar for levs they needed for pending payments," another dealer said.
Banks were reluctant to pare forex positions in anticipation of a new lev fall amid growing political and social unrest and uncertain prospects of foreign funding, traders said.

President Zhelyu Zhelev has declined to invite the Socialists' premier-designate Nikolai Dobrev to form a new cabinet to replace the outgoing Socialist government of Prime Minister Zhan Videnov, who resigned in December.
